links.outcome: Perceived understandability of SHAP explanations with LLM text plus visuals versus visual-only
links.effect: Generated contextual text explanations were perceived as more understandable and contextually appropriate than visual-only outputs (Likert surveys and interviews; preliminary findings).
links.quote: The results, based on Likert-scale surveys and follow-up interviews, indicate that the generated explanations were perceived as more understandable and contextually appropriate compared to visual-only outputs.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to convert SHAP feature-importance output into contextualized textual explanations, guided by user-defined feature aliases, descriptions and background

screen.reason: Evaluates whether adding contextualized LLM-generated explanations alongside traditional visual SHAP outputs improves user understandability in a healthcare case study.

primary.practice: LLM-generated contextual natural language explanation of SHAP outputs
